description: Java source code for an Android activity demonstrating key derivation and encryption/decryption, including insecure and secure methods, with mock data handling and file operations.

classes.name: BrokenKeyDerivationActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating key derivation, encryption, decryption, and mock data handling for insecure and secure key management.

methods.name: deriveKeyInsecurely
methods.description: Derives an insecure AES key emulating SHA1PRNG algorithm from a password.

methods.name: deriveKeySecurely
methods.description: Derives a secure AES key from a password using PBKDF2 with HMACSHA1.

methods.name: retrieveData
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted data, re-encrypts if stored with insecure key, and returns decrypted string with warning or success message.

methods.name: encryptOrDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption with CBC mode and PKCS7 padding.

methods.name: cleanRoomStart
methods.description: Initializes mock encrypted data and deletes related files.

methods.name: isDataStoredWithInsecureKey
methods.description: Checks if data is stored with an insecure key based on file existence.

methods.name: retrieveIv
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a random IV for encryption.

methods.name: retrieveSalt
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a salt for key derivation.

methods.name: storeDataEncryptedWithSecureKey
methods.description: Stores encrypted data and marks it as securely encrypted.

methods.name: readFromFileOrCreateRandom
methods.description: Reads bytes from a file or creates random bytes if file doesn't exist.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes bytes to a specified file.

methods.name: readBytesFromFile
methods.description: Reads bytes from a file into a byte array.
